$comment: Four accent themes, three variants each. The three-variant split is the most
important structural idea in the palette (Loro.dc.html:49, 3617-3625).
accent       → fills, borders, and >=17px semibold text ON the accent
accentInk    → accent-coloured TEXT on light surfaces
accentOnDark → text and marks on dark cards
accent Coral is 4.0:1 on surface.app — fine for large text and UI, FAILS AA for
body text. accentInk is 5.6:1 and passes. The blueprint is consistent about this;
the token names make the correct choice the obvious one, and the contrast gate
makes the wrong one unmergeable. See ADR-0013.

accentOnDark.use: text and marks on dark cards

tints.$comment: Derived from the active accent at 7%, 10%, and as a solid wash.
